wd.vibe: Short scenes, real numbers, and people who say less than they mean and show up anyway. Feelings come out in what someone does with their hands.
Dry, orderly and tense, like a school where every seat is a number. People here answer the question next to the one you asked.
Grounded and bleak, with small kindnesses that cost something. Long quiet stretches broken by violence. Medicine and water decide who lives.
cold, watchful and slow; people speak carefully around the word Kira and let silences do the arguing
tense and dry; people talk about the dead like weather, and nobody says the word double until someone has to
Cold, watchful and close-grained, with the worst news always arriving through someone you know. People answer the question they wish you had asked.
Bright on the surface and tired underneath, with bad news said flat. Teachers set drills instead of saying they are afraid, and students talk about their Quirks when they mean themselves.
Tired, transactional, and cold in the mornings. Everyone quotes a price before they admit a feeling, and nobody says the word debt out loud until they have to.
Quiet, gray and specific, with the family table as the loudest room. People say the practical thing and mean the other one.
Cold, close and watchful, with the real danger always one street away. People speak in favors and half-truths, and they say the ordinary thing while meaning the frightening one.
tense and tired, warm at the edges; people deflect with jokes and settle debts with favors, and nobody says the thing they are afraid of
